decisions_where_design_was_silent_or_spl: A model pick that equals the procedure's own default, the step taken with no model, is taken with basis 'deduction'. The basis rule covers a change whose ONLY basis is the model's pick, and the default would be taken even with no model loaded.

Agent steps carry no dial (owner decision 2: free action inside an assignment). The card for a model-picked change is therefore shown at every dial, and the rule is checked with stacy_hand.hers at the freest place. Local helpers and operations the Kernel does not list count as changes (B2's undo class), so a model pick of one is a card too.

Arguments of an agent step that the model picked get origin DEDUCTION, with the proof 'step <key> of the <profile> procedure, built from your assignment'. The procedure built them; the model only picked the option's number.

App plans (design 5.2): the only path where a model-written change landed by itself is D19's documents.edit on the open page. I kept D19 for requests that ask for a change, meaning they hold one of the owner's change verbs outside quotes (CHANGE_WORDS, verbs only, so 'what is the title?' asks for nothing). Any other request gets the card, at every dial. This is narrower than checking that the words name the exact kind of change. A stricter check would have broken the owner's own window check ('make the words I picked stand out' gives bold). Say if you want the stricter one.

The verb table lives in desk_acts (MODEL_VERBS), because lane B owns desk_acts and the design calls it a view over desk_acts.ACTS. It holds only the verbs that are desk acts today. The reading routes why, total, within and find are reads that B3's understand.py adds, and B3 should build its grammar from MODEL_VERBS plus those routes. Opening an App is in no row, and model_may refuses go.app, head.open Apps and programs.* by name.

Her door: 0.8.6's her_door still refuses every 'changes' act (NOT_YET), so no change can come through her hand today. B1 still sends the turn's basis to desk_hers, so a model-picked turn cannot open an App, and when B3 opens changes they already ask.
